column1: # What a person keeps: their own documents, as the web keeps them
# (puikit: persisted in app/phi-kit/src/api.ts). Each is kept in the
# person's own folder for Phiogy and, with Phiora answering, on Phiora
# under their session, by the same names the web's pages use, so what
# is written in one is there in the other: a name, a value.
# The file of the folder the documents are in, and the one that holds
# the session Phiora gave, which is sent back the next time so the
# person is the same one there.
# The documents: `doc.` and what the code calls it, then the name
# What the person wrote in each room; the marks they gave; what they
# pinned and unpinned; the rooms they opened; whom they follow.
# The hosts the person joined or left, and the ones they made; whom
# they began a conversation with; how they stand with each person.
# When the person opened each room last, and the rooms they starred.
# Every call this window was in: the room, when, who, how long (never
# The shops the person opened or closed; their bag; what they bought.
# The things of the shops the person likes.
# The wallet and its history. These two are Phiora's to write, so with
# Phiora answering a change to them is never sent as a document: the
# money is moved by asking (`ask.` rows: what the code calls an ask,
# Who the person is, as Phiora says it: the names in what it answers
# when asked (their id, name and handle, whether they are a guest, and
# whether anyone may be one of its members to try things); what it is
# asked for those members by, to be one of them (and the name their id
# is sent under), and to be nobody again.
# Whom the person muted, and the theme they wear (a thing of a shop,
# by its shop and its id). The web keeps neither as a document: a mute
# does nothing there, and what is worn is its theme's own setting.
# Signing in with a handle and a password: what it is asked by, the
# names the two are sent under, and the name of what Phiora says when
# The sessions signed in as the person: what they are asked by, the
# names of what each is on and of whether it is this one; signing the
# others out, and the name that says the others; and taking out
# everything Phiora keeps about the person, with the name the file of
# it is given before the person says where to keep it.
